{{Quote|Facial transformation program loaded.|[[Unidentified 2-1B surgical droid (Jedi Temple)|Jedi Temple 2-1B surgical droid]]|<ref name="Deception" />}}
A '''facial transformation program''' altered the facial bone and muscle structure of an individual to [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|transform]] their physical appearance into that of another person.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discovered a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during a celebration on his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] developed a plan to go deep undercover to extract information from the conspirators. To accomplish this, Kenobi faked his own [[Death/Legends|death]] and in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Transformation chamber/Legends|medical labs]] was subjected to a facial transformation program which transformed him into the likeness of the very criminal who supposedly [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] him, [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].<ref name="Deception" />
